major_cooldowns.name: Stormkeeper
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown and dump the charges into Lightning Bolt, or Chain Lightning in AoE, but hold it briefly when Ascendance is nearly ready so it goes out just before you ascend.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 191634 is both the cast id and the self aura in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it straight after Stormkeeper so its Flame Shocks and the 75% stronger overloads land together, then keep it roughly on cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 114050 is the Flame Ascendant cast; the player aura logs as 1219480.

major_cooldowns.name: Ancestral Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown, and in a burst window fire it right after Stormkeeper so its Ancestor is out before Ascendance.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Farseer hero talent that replaces Nature's Swiftness; cast in 5/5 sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Spiritwalker's Grace
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it as movement starts so you keep hardcasting Lava Burst and Lightning Bolt instead of losing casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Empowering Venom
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it with Ascendance, or early enough that it is back up for the next Ascendance.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket effect id; only players wearing this trinket log casts, so zero casts is normal.

major_cooldowns.name: Emberwing Heatwave
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it with Ascendance, or early enough that it is back up for the next Ascendance.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket effect id; only players wearing this trinket log casts, so zero casts is normal.

defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Press it just before a big hit or a damage phase to take 40% less damage.

defensives.name: Earth Elemental
defensives.usage_rule: Summon it to pull adds off you and hold them while you keep casting.

rules.description: Open Stormkeeper into Lava Burst then Ascendance
rules.action: Precast Stormkeeper and Lava Burst, then open with Ascendance.
Press Stormkeeper first so Ascendance amplifies its overloads.

rules.description: Keep Flame Shock rolling on the boss
rules.action: Refresh Flame Shock inside its pandemic window so it never falls off.

rules.description: Spend Maelstrom before hardcasting Lava Burst
rules.action: Spend down with Elemental Blast or Earth Shock before you press Lava Burst.

rules.description: Chain Lightning replaces Lightning Bolt in AoE
rules.action: Switch your filler to Chain Lightning as soon as extra enemies are up.

rules.description: Earthquake is your spender on big packs
rules.action: Spend with Elemental Blast on small packs and save Earthquake for bigger ones.
